digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler snapshot persistence and differ
propositions: prev_snapshot.json currently stores full ACLI payloads at 228.1 MB total size (4.5 MB per day), consuming excessive storage when only Jira key sets are semantically necessary for differ operations.

Narrowing prev_snapshot to a dict {jira_key: {}} reduces payload from 27.1 MB to 19,960 bytes at HEAD while maintaining byte-identical snapshots across 218 of 399 consecutive key-set pairs, eliminating unnecessary commits.

The differ emits 973-998 unbound_local create mutations when prev contains keys absent from curr due to fetch window shrinkage or project re-targeting; key-set prev eliminates this source of wasted mutations without changing observable Jira-facing behavior.

The production call-site filter drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions acts as the load-bearing backstop that prevents both field_drift and unbound_local emissions from reaching dispatch, making key-set shape safe even where local state is absent.

Prev-shape-sensitive consumers (check_dual_identity_complete, differ local-only/emit-both arms) require mapping entries to support guard patterns like local_state[key] or {}, necessitating dict storage rather than set and tolerating {} entries on first pass after cutover.
